target.title: fix(agents): add additionalProperties:false to Anthropic tool inputSchema for Opus 4.8 compat
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`tools.profile=coding` + `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8` returns HTTP 400 because opus-4-8 enforces **JSON Schema draft 2020-12** validation on tool `input_schema` (opus-4-7 was lenient). When tool parameters contain draft-07 tuple syntax, the Anthropic API rejects the request.

**Root cause**: `additionalProperties: false` is not the real issue — opus-4-8 accepts schemas without `additionalProperties` (200 OK). The real cause is that draft-07 tuple `items: [...]` and `additionalItems` syntax was replaced by `prefixItems` in draft 2020-12. opus-4-8 rejects schemas containing these legacy constructs with:

```
400 tools.0.custom.input_schema: JSON schema is invalid.
It must match JSON Schema draft 2020-12
```

**Fix**: Add `normalizeAnthropicSchema`, a recursive normalizer that converts all draft-07 tuple syntax to draft 2020-12 at the Anthropic-specific choke point (`projectAnthropicTools`), while preserving the existing `additionalProperties: false`.

## Conversion Rules (pure syntax rename, zero semantic change)

| draft-07 | draft 2020-12 |
|----------|---------------|
| `items: [A, B, C]` | `prefixItems: [A, B, C]` (delete `items`) |
| `additionalItems: X` | `items: X` (delete `additionalItems`) |
| `items: {...}` (single schema) | unchanged |
| `items: false` | unchanged |

Identity-preserving: returns the original object reference when no changes are needed. Recursively traverses all JSON Schema nesting keywords: `properties`, `$defs`, `definitions`, `dependentSchemas`, `patternProperties`, `anyOf`, `oneOf`, `allOf`, `if`/`then`/`else`, `not`, `contains`, `items`, `prefixItems`, `additionalProperties`, `propertyNames`.

## Architecture

The fix applies at the **single Anthropic-specific choke point** (`projectAnthropicTools`), keeping the shared `projectRuntimeToolInputSchema()` provider-agnostic:

```
All upstream schema sources (Zod / TypeBox / MCP / Plugin SDK / user-defined)
         ↓
  projectRuntimeToolInputSchema()  ← shared: JSON-ifies schema, checks violations (no provider logic)
         ↓
  projectAnthropicTools()          ← Anthropic-specific choke point
    └─ normalizeAnthropicSchema()  ← NEW: recursive draft 2020-12 normalization (Anthropic only)
         ↓
  input_schema                     ← sent to Anthropic API
```

Both Anthropic API consumers share the same path:
- [anthropic-transport-stream.ts:562](src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts#L562) — agent transport
- [anthropic.ts:1489](src/llm/providers/anthropic.ts#L1489) — provider path

Reference implementation: `normalizeOpenAIStrictCompatSchemaRecursive` ([provider-tools.ts:216](src/plugin-sdk/provider-tools.ts#L216)) — same recursive traversal pattern.

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/agents/anthropic-schema-normalizer.ts` | **New** — recursive draft 2020-12 normalizer (104 lines) |
| `src/agents/anthropic-schema-normalizer.test.ts` | **New** — 18 test cases |
| `src/agents/anthropic-tool-projection.test.ts` | **New** — 4 consumer-path pipeline tests covering tuple→prefixItems |
| `src/agents/anthropic-tool-projection.ts` | **Modified** — `additionalProperties: false` + `normalizeAnthropicSchema()` call at the Anthropic-specific choke point |
| `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts` | **Modified** — regression assertion for `additionalProperties: false` |
| `src/llm/providers/anthropic.test.ts` | **Modified** — regression assertion for `additionalProperties: false` |

## Evidence

### Tests: 162/162 passing

```
$ pnpm test src/agents/anthropic-tool-projection.test.ts \
  src/agents/anthropic-schema-normalizer.test.ts \
  src/agents/tool-schema-projection.test.ts \
  src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts \
  src/agents/anthropic-payload-policy.test.ts \
  src/llm/providers/anthropic.test.ts

 Test Files  6 passed (6)
      Tests  162 passed (162)
```

### New unit tests — normalizer (18 cases)

| Scenario | Assertion |
|----------|-----------|
| No-change identity-preserving | `expect(normalize(s)).toBe(s)` |
| `items: [A, B]` → `prefixItems` | `{ type: "array", prefixItems: [...] }` |
| `items: {...}` single schema unchanged | `toBe(s)` |
| `items: false` unchanged | `toBe(s)` |
| Existing `prefixItems` not overwritten | preserves existing `prefixItems` |
| Empty `items: []` → empty `prefixItems` | `{ prefixItems: [] }` |
| `additionalItems: false` → `items: false` | `{ items: false }` |
| `additionalItems: {...}` → `items: {...}` | schema correctly transferred |
| Does not overwrite existing `items` | preserves existing `items` |
| `items` tuple + `additionalItems` together | `prefixItems` + `items` |
| Deep nesting in `properties` | recursive conversion |
| Tuple inside `anyOf` | recursive conversion |
| `oneOf` + `allOf` combination | recursive conversion |
| Tuple inside `$defs` | recursive conversion |
| `additionalItems` in `properties` values | recursive conversion |
| Multi-level deep nesting | through anyOf→properties→array |

### New consumer-path pipeline tests — projection (4 cases)

| Scenario | Assertion |
|----------|-----------|
| Tuple `items` → `prefixItems` + `additionalItems` → `items` | Full pipeline: tool descriptor → projected `input_schema` with `prefixItems` + `items: false`, `additionalItems` removed |
| Deep nested tuple through `anyOf` | Tool with `anyOf` → projected schema converts inner tuple to `prefixItems` |
| Single-schema `items` identity | `items: { type: "string" }` unchanged, no `prefixItems` added |
| `additionalProperties: false` preserved | Top-level `inputSchema.additionalProperties` === `false` |

### Live API verification (credit: @brandencho)

Verified against real opus-4-8 API with single-tool requests:

| tool input_schema | result |
|-------------------|--------|
| no top-level `additionalProperties` | ✅ 200 |
| `+ additionalProperties: false` | ✅ 200 |
| `patternProperties`, `anyOf+null`, `{}`, `additionalProperties:true`, dangling `$ref` | ✅ 200 |
| tuple `items: [...]` (draft-07) | ❌ 400 "must match JSON Schema draft 2020-12" |
| tuple `items: [...]` + `additionalProperties: false` (previous PR) | ❌ 400 |
| `prefixItems: [...]` (draft 2020-12) | ✅ 200 |

### Lint / Format

| Check | Result |
|-------|--------|
| oxlint | zero errors, zero warnings |
| oxfmt | correct formatting |

- Fixes #98588
